normality_check_outcome_score.plain_english: Shapiro-Wilk test on primary outcome score (W=0.998, p=0.050): data deviates significantly from a normal distribution — a non-parametric test (Kruskal-Wallis / Mann-Whitney) is recommended.

primary_endpoint_ttest.plain_english: On average, the Drug X arm scored 9.05 points higher than Placebo on primary outcome score (0-100) (60.19 vs 51.14). This difference is statistically significant (Welch's t=18.05, p=< 0.001), meaning we would see a difference this large by chance in fewer than 0.1% of repeated trials. The effect size is large (Cohen's d = 0.81).

ci_outcome_drug_x.plain_english: The 95% confidence interval for Drug X primary outcome score is [59.39, 60.99] around a sample mean of 60.19 (n=1000).

ci_outcome_placebo.plain_english: The 95% confidence interval for Placebo primary outcome score is [50.57, 51.71] around a sample mean of 51.14 (n=1000).

hba1c_control_chisq.plain_english: A chi-square test of independence was run on HbA1c <7% control at Week 24 across treatment arms (chi2=218.75, dof=1, p=< 0.001). There is a statistically significant association between treatment arm and HbA1c <7% control at Week 24.

ae_occurrence_chisq.plain_english: A chi-square test of independence was run on adverse event occurrence across treatment arms (chi2=127.61, dof=1, p=< 0.001). There is a statistically significant association between treatment arm and adverse event occurrence.

ae_severity_class_chisq.plain_english: A chi-square test of independence was run on adverse event severity class across treatment arms (chi2=196.71, dof=2, p=< 0.001). There is a statistically significant association between treatment arm and adverse event severity class.

kruskal_hba1c_by_ae_class.plain_english: A Kruskal-Wallis test compared HbA1c reduction by Week 24, grouped by worst AE severity across 3 groups without assuming normally distributed data (H=83.74, p=< 0.001). The groups differ significantly in HbA1c reduction by Week 24, grouped by worst AE severity. Median values: No AE=0.40, Mild AE=0.67, Severe AE=0.58.
